summary: A well presented two bedroom, terraced house with off street parking. Offered on a unfurnished basis.
description:
Well presented in a quiet residential cul-de-sac, this well laid out and conveniently positioned property is ideal for those looking to let in the area.

Situated within a 10 minute drive of Workington town centre, within 35 minutes of Carlisle and just under half an hour to Sellafield, this property is ideal for commuters. Equally the second bedroom in the property would make a very nice home office for those remote working.

Finished in neutral tones, and with the benefit of a low maintenance rear garden and conservatory, this property is sure to be popular!

Available on an unfurnished basis but some white goods are included. EPC: C

The accommodation briefly comprises: Porch, Lounge, Kitchen, Conservatory, 2 Bedrooms, 3 Piece Bathroom, Rear Garden, Off Road Parking for 2 Vehicles, Gas CH & DG.

Council Tax Band: A

The equivalent of one week's worth of rent is payable as a holding deposit whilst referencing checks are undertaken.

A deposit of 5 x weeks rent will be payable at the commencment of tenancy along with the first months rent.
